name: Discrete Wavelet Transform Loss
definition: A regularization loss that applies Discrete Wavelet Transform to rendered images to supervise low and mid-frequency structures, prioritizing low frequencies by weighting the LL sub-band higher than others.
summary: Discrete Wavelet Transform Loss is a NeRF regularization term that minimizes frequency representation differences via patch-based sub-band decomposition, prioritizing low-frequency learning to address high-frequency overfitting.
